items.quote: Several respondents noted that Jomon was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of long-term strategy for the sector.
Several respondents noted that Jomon championed the team's recovery after a major project setback and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Several respondents noted that Jomon set the direction for policy options for the cabinet paper on ageing across the public service.
He led presentations to senior management across the department.
Jomon headed analytics to guide resource allocation, setting priorities for several teams.
He spearheaded customer feedback improvements at service centres at the national level.
He took ownership of lean process reviews at the service centres and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Jomon Osberly drove stakeholder consultations for the licensing review for the whole division.
Peers observed that Jomon Osberly spearheaded teamwork across departments on the annual review at the national level.
He delivered his share of change management after the merger of two units reliably.
Direct reports said that Jomon Osberly led upholding governance and audit standards across the department.
Direct reports said that Jomon led bilateral negotiations on the water agreement across the department.
He headed emergency coordination during the flood response, setting priorities for several teams.
Peers observed that Jomon took ownership of root cause analysis of recurring service failures and steered it to completion.
